CORRIGENDUM TO THE E-TENDER NOTICE F.No.31/27/2022-E&F(SIA)
DATED 03.02.2022

Whereas the Department had published E-tender vide F.No.31/27/2022-E&F(SIA)
dated 03.02.2022 for the empanelment of agencies to conduct Social Impact Assessment
studies at Lakshadweep as per the various provisions in the Right to Fair Compensation
and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act-2013 (30 Of
2013) and Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement (Social Impact Assessment & Consent) Rules 2014.

And whereas the last date for accepting this tender was 15.02.2022. Now in order
to have wider participation for this tender, the time schedule described at para 8.1 had
been rescheduled as below.
8.1 Time schedule for obtaining bid documents, submission of bids and opening of bids
as follows.
